interventions.detail: No conda in the image; used a uv venv on system Python 3.12 instead of the documented conda python=3.9 env
The conda commands install pytorch 1.13/cuda 11.6, which contradicts the supported PyTorch 2.1-2.4.1 range; installed CPU torch 2.4.1 + torchvision 0.19.1
apt-get install python3-dev (Python.h missing during the C++ extension build)
pip install -e . needs --no-build-isolation (with setuptools/wheel/ninja preinstalled) so the build can import torch
Set PYTORCH3D_FORCE_NO_CUDA=1 so only the CPU extension is built even though the CUDA toolkit is present
Pinned numpy<2 as a precaution for torch 2.4.1 (not tested without it)
